description.value: Huong Lan is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant that has been a Nanaimo institution since 1998, voted the #1 Asian restaurant in Nanaimo by the Nanaimo News Bulletin every year from 2013 to 2022. The menu centres on pho, wonton soup, grilled lemongrass chicken, and bubble tea, with dedicated gluten-free and vegan options. Located in a plaza on Bowen Road, it offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery — a reliable hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through central Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at lanfood.ca confirms a long-established family-owned Vietnamese restaurant at 19-1925 Bowen Rd, Nanaimo, operating since 1998. The site explicitly offers dine-in, takeout, and DoorDash delivery, and the full menu page lists dedicated gluten-free and vegan sections. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website contact page.
OSM has minimal tags (amenity + name only); coordinates cannot be cross-checked against the Bowen Rd address without mapping tools.
Business also has a second location in Parksville (150 Hirst Ave E) — ensure the OSM node coordinates correspond to the Nanaimo location specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant with takeout and GF/vegan options makes it a practical and reliable meal stop for touring cyclists in Nanaimo.
